How it works

From product link to ready-to-run video in three steps — you approve the script before anything is produced.

  1. 1 Send the brief

    Product link, the benefit that matters, and anything the ad must never say. Two minutes with the brief builder below.

  2. 2 Approve script + creator

    You get the timed script and creator pick first. Change the hook, the persona, the claims — production starts only on your yes.

  3. 3 Post it, test the hooks

    Finished vertical videos land in about 48 hours, each with 3 hooks. Run them against each other and keep the winner.

Every video includes

  • 3 hook variationsSame body, three different first-3-seconds — built for A/B testing.
  • Burned-in captionsWord-timed captions in your brand colors, plus a clean copy for platform captions.
  • All three crops9:16 master with 4:5 and 1:1 safe-zone exports for feeds.
  • Full paid-usage rightsRun it in ads as long as you like. No expiry, no renewal fees.
  • One revision roundPacing, wording, or caption fixes on the produced video.
  • AI-content labelingDelivered with the disclosure each platform requires for AI-generated ads.

Fair questions

Will viewers know it’s AI?

The creators are AI-generated, and the ads carry the AI-content label each platform requires. In practice the format reads like any creator ad — selfie framing, real rooms, natural delivery — which is exactly why brands test hooks with it before spending on human creators.

What do you need from me?

A product link, a few product photos if you have them, the one benefit to sell, and your no-go claims. That’s the whole brief — the builder above generates it for you.

What if I don’t like the video?

You approve the script and creator before production, and every video includes one revision round for pacing, wording, and captions. If the delivered video doesn’t match the approved script, it gets remade.

Can I put my winning hook in front of a real creator later?

Yes — that’s the most common play. Test 3–5 hooks as AI ads, find the one that holds attention, then hand that exact script to a human creator for the launch version. The script is yours.
